sections.title: Conditional probability: choose the reference group

blocks.setup: 25 of 40 students commute; 10 commuters cycle. Find the percentage of commuters who cycle.

steps.label: Reference group
steps.text: Commuters: 25 students. The question asks for the share among this group.

blocks.takeaway: The denominator is the reference group (commuters), not the full class of 40.

blocks.text: Report proportions as percentages rounded to one decimal place and name the reference group.

sections.title: Two-way tables: row vs. column percentages

blocks.text: In a two-way table, the worked commuter calculation is a percentage for the commuter group: the cell count divided by that group's total.
Split cases by a categorical variable; compute one summary (such as a mean or count) per group.
Output: one row per non-empty group, not one row per original case. Compare groups using the same summary: mean with mean, count with count.
